title: Give a closed feature's promote reminder a working clear command
action: Per D10 (issue 107). `pub(crate) fn unapplied_promote_proposals(` in verbs/status_full/mod.rs clears a feature when its scribing ledger stamp is newer than promote-proposals.md OR a `promote` item in .bee/deferred-queue.jsonl for that feature is completed (`deferred_queue::items_for(root, "promote", &feature)`). `bee close` enqueues that item (enqueue_promote_deferred_record in verbs/drivers/close.rs), and `bee deferred-queue complete --id <id>` exists, but nothing tells the user, a completion may need a prior claim, and features closed before the queue existed have no item. Make one command clear the reminder from any phase: `bee deferred-queue complete --kind promote --feature <f>`. Under the queue lock it completes that feature's open promote item when one exists, else appends an `add` event and a `complete` event for the feature — no claim logic. Keep `--id` working as today; refuse when neither `--id` nor `--kind`+`--feature` is given; refuse `--kind promote --feature <f>` when docs/history/<f>/promote-proposals.md does not exist. Add the flags to the parse_shape list in try_native (no catalog or regen change: catalog.rs holds no deferred-queue entry). Add a `clear_command` string to `UnappliedPromoteProposal` (verbs/status_full/mod.rs) and print it on the reminder line, worded as "after you apply or decide to skip the proposals: <command>", in both renderers: hooks/session_preamble/render.rs and verbs/status_full/orient.rs (rg -n UnappliedPromoteProposal). In verbs/state_group/store.rs `check_scribing_run_phase` has no feature in scope: append to its refusal a fixed clause naming `bee deferred-queue complete --kind promote --feature <feature>` for clearing a closed feature's promote reminder, and extend the existing refusal assert in verbs/state_group/tests.rs. Red first: a test that a feature with promote-proposals.md and no queue item is listed, then after the complete-by-feature call is not listed; the extended refusal assert. No code comments. If cargo fails to compile in a file outside your files list, a sibling cell is mid-edit: wait 60 seconds and re-run; never edit that file. Update hooks/session_preamble/tests.rs where it pins the reminder line.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee promote && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee deferred_queue && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee scribing
